commenti.body: How good is Emma in the movie? I’ve seen people say that she really shines in the third but doesn’t really get that much to do in the first two? Still seems like Plemos and then her are getting the most highlights, excited to see the movie and also their next collaboration with Yogos.

Emma doesn't do much in the 1st but she does do a lot in the 2nd and gets to shine the most in the 3rd.

That said I don't think Emma's acting is showcased that much even in the 3rd. Her comedic timing is great though.

Gotcha. From the description of the first two stories it does sound like Plemons gets two play two characters who are sorta “regular” guys who slowly start to go crazy as their lives spiral out of control, which is something he is incredible at. Excited to see him finally getting some big juicy roles. From what you said I do wish Emma had a similar level of opportunities to showcase her skills as a Plemons did tho, I think she does her best work with Yorgos.
